s: Today we talk about family and a happy wedding day.
Yes, a wedding is a happy day for a whole family.
Today we learn five easy words about family.
A bride is a woman on her wedding day.
The bride wears a beautiful white dress, and everyone looks at the bride.
A bridegroom is a man on his wedding day.
The bridegroom wears a dark suit, and he stands next to the bride.
So the bride and the bridegroom stand together.
The bride smiles at the bridegroom, and the bridegroom smiles at the bride.
Children are young people, sons and daughters.
At the wedding, the children wear nice clothes, and the children dance and play.
The children sing songs, and the children eat cake with the family.
The fourth word is call after.
When we call a baby after a person, we give the baby that person's name.
For example, they will call the baby after her grandmother.
That is a lovely family tradition.
They call the baby after her grandmother because they love the grandmother.
So the baby and the grandmother share one name.
Let me say it again in a simple way.
Call after means to name a baby with another person's name.
Call after is a sweet family tradition.
When a family uses call after, they honor the grandmother.
Call after keeps the family name alive for the children.
The fifth word is can't stand.
When you can't stand something, you really dislike it.
For example, I can't stand loud music.
Some people can't stand loud music at a party.
But at this wedding, the music is soft, so nobody says, I can't stand this music.

The bride and the bridegroom walk into the garden.

The bride thanks her family, and the bridegroom thanks his family too.

Do they play loud music at dinner?
No, they play soft music, because the grandmother can't stand loud music.
She says, I can't stand loud music, so please play soft music.
